title: Attio footer
description: A dark full-width footer: the wordmark at the top left, link groups in four columns on the right (two on phones) with grey group titles, small blue 'new' pills and ↗ marks for outside links, then social icons and a quiet copyright and legal row along the bottom.
notes: forces the dark palette and marks itself data-header-tone="dark" for the attio header
groups choose their desktop and phone column (column / phoneColumn); otherwise they fill columns in turn
